title: QA Engineer: Platform Games
description:
Founded in 1972, Atari is one of the world's most iconic consumer brands and a pioneer in the video game industry, recognized worldwide for its multi-platform games and licensed products. Atari owns and/or manages a portfolio of more than 400 games and franchises, including globally recognized brands such as Asteroids®, Centipede®, Missile Command®, Pong®, and RollerCoaster Tycoon®.

The Atari family of brands includes Digital Eclipse, Nightdive Studios, Infogrames, AtariAge, MobyGames, as well as Coatsink, Early Morning Studios, and Stormteller Games—spanning game development, publishing, and community experiences worldwide. Today, Atari Inc. continues to build on its legacy by developing games, hardware, and experiences that honor the past while driving innovation for the future.

Over the past two years, we've been building Atari India, a growing team that plays a critical role in supporting our global operations. We're proud of the team we've assembled so far, and we're just getting started. As part of a lean, high-impact organization, the team in India works closely with colleagues in North America and Europe on projects that move the company forward. Whether you're helping launch a new game, keeping our infrastructure secure, or supporting day-to-day operations, your work here matters. Join us as we continue to grow Atari India and build the future of a legendary brand.

  

**Position:** QA Engineer Platform Games  
**Experience:** 2-4 years  
**Location:** Netaji Subhash Place, Pitampura, Delhi  
**Employment Type:** Contract role  
**Work Timings:** 9AM - 6PM IST  
  
**Overview**

We're reimagining Atari's classic arcade catalog as short-session games for Reddit, MSN and emerging channels. We need a QA Engineer who can catch problems before players do, keep releases moving on tight timelines, and make sure every title meets platform certification standards before it goes live.

### **What You'll Do**

* Test each title through the full pipeline: functional, regression, compatibility and performance testing before every release
* Look past surface bugs to judge the whole experience: gameplay feel, pacing, difficulty balance, onboarding and UX, not just whether the UI technically works
* Write and maintain test plans and test cases for internal and outsourced titles
* File clear, reproducible bug reports and track them through to a verified fix
* Check builds against platform certification requirements (Reddit, MSN) before submission
* Work closely with producers and developers to triage issues and keep releases on schedule
* Test across multiple devices, browsers and aspect ratios, since these games need to hold up on any screen
* Watch for performance issues like slow load times, dropped frames and memory spikes, and document them with clear repro steps
* Run regression passes after patches and live-ops updates
* Track quality metrics such as crash rate, open bug count and time-to-fix, and report weekly
* Use AI tools to speed through repetitive work, like drafting test cases or doing a first pass on logs, so you can move on to the next title sooner

### **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 3+ years in QA/testing for games (mobile, casual or browser titles)
* Experience testing Unity and/or HTML5 games across browsers, devices and aspect ratios
* An eye for UX as well as UI: you notice when something feels off even when nothing is technically broken
* Good bug-reporting discipline: clear repro steps, sensible severity calls, thorough verification after fixes
* Comfortable running QA on several titles at once within tight release windows
* Some familiarity with platform certification or submission requirements (Reddit, MSN or similar)
* Used to working with AI tools day to day, for things like generating test cases, scanning logs or drafting reports, to get through routine work faster.
* Exposure to live-ops testing: post-launch patches, events, seasonal content
* Basic scripting or test automation experience

**Preferred**

* Passion for retro/arcade gaming and the Atari catalog
* Experience with bug tracking or test management tools such as Jira or TestRail

### **Why Join Us?**

* Build in gaming, not just hire for it: real ownership and direct access to leadership
* Hybrid, flexible, trust-driven environment
* Zero-cost comprehensive medical cover
* Ambitious, collaborative, genuinely fun team

### **E****EO Statement**

*Atari is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We are committed to equal employment regardless of race, religion or lack thereof, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, medical condition, veteran status, ancestry, disability status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.*

title: Engineer, TSG Software Quality Assurance
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  
  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  
  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

This position sits within an agile data engineering team, owning the quality of end-to-end data pipelines from source ingestion through medallion-layer transformation (Bronze/Silver/Gold) to BI/reporting consumption. The role suits someone who thinks like a data architect and builds/tests like an engineer, equally comfortable with pipeline design and hands-on SQL, PySpark, and automated data quality frameworks.

  
  

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

The engineer independently owns the data testing strategy for their workstream, including a reusable SQL validation library usable for both manual and automated checks, and constructively challenges design or process decisions that risk data integrity or delivery quality. Works closely with Data Engineers, the QA Manager, Product/Project Managers, and business stakeholders.

  
  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Requirement, Project and Business Understanding (20%)**

* Develop deep expertise in the data domain and business context source systems, transformation logic, medallion layers, and downstream BI consumption.
Build a thorough understanding of the pipeline lifecycle (ingestion staging transformation* curated/BI layer).
* Review source-to-target mappings and transformation logic before test design begins.
* Support the team on data QA methodologies and processes, with guidance from QA leadership.

**Test Planning, Design, Execution, and Defect Management (35%)**

* Own the data testing strategy across full, incremental, delta, and historical loads, including insert/update/delete/cancel and effective-dated transactions.
* Design and execute ETL/ELT validation, reconciliation, schema, null/completeness, and transformation test cases across the medallion architecture.
* Validate pipelines end-to-end source through Databricks/ADF/Spark to final BI output, confirming numbers, aggregations, and business logic tie out.
* Define and enforce data quality rules and build reusable checks; investigate anomalies and drive root-cause analysis with Data Engineers.
* Manage the defect lifecycle and prepare test evidence, quality dashboards, and RCA reporting for release sign-off.

**SQL Script & Automation Engineering (20%)**

* Build and maintain a structured, version-controlled Databricks/SQL validation queries usable standalone for manual checks and pluggable into automated regression/CI without rework.
* Own inline maintenance of the library: refactor as schemas evolve, retire obsolete checks, keep naming and parameterization consistent, and document each script's purpose, inputs, expected output, and edge cases so it stays usable by the wider team.
* Set up and maintain automated data testing frameworks (e.g., Datagaps, PySpark-based checks) that consume the library for scheduled/CI-triggered runs.
* Work with Data Engineers to wire validation into CI/CD, ensuring failures surface with actionable, traceable output.

**Collaboration (15%)**

* Provide input into the test strategy mix (manual/automated/framework-driven) in partnership with QA leadership and data engineering.
* Constructively challenge decisions that risk data quality or testability and propose practical alternatives.
* Participate fully in agile ceremonies; raise risks and quality concerns early and clearly.
* Partner with the business to understand the wider data system and act as a quality partner for delivery.

**Leadership (10%)**

* Own data testing deliverables, including the health of the automation/SQL library, for the workstream.
* Lead or contribute to QA initiatives that raise the bar on data testing practice across the team.
* Mentor junior testers on ETL/data testing techniques, SQL standards, and automation tooling
  

  

**ABOUT YOU**

* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, dimensional modeling, fact/dimension tables, and medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), with the ability to trace a data point end-to-end into its BI report representation.
* Hands-on proficiency with Azure SQL/Databricks/Apache Spark (PySpark) for large-scale data validation and transformation testing.
* Working knowledge of Azure Data Factory (pipelines, linked services), Azure Storage (partitioning, Parquet/Delta), and third-party API integrations (e.g., Salesforce, etc.)
* Advanced SQL for backend validation and reconciliation across SQL Server/PostgreSQL/Databricks, with emphasis on writing maintainable, reusable, parameterized scripts.
* Working knowledge of Python for test scripting and validation automation.
* Practical exposure to ETL/data quality tools, Datagaps DataOps Suite (good to have), or equivalent (DQX, QuerySurge, Informatica, Talend, DataStage, SSIS).
* Ability to define and apply data quality rules systematically (completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness).
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted test generation or anomaly detection, with the ability to adapt checks for AI-produced and consumed data pipelines.

* Comfort with Agile/Kanban delivery, CI/CD practices, and defect management tooling (JIRA, Azure Boards, or similar).
* A curious, quality-first mindset confident to constructively challenge decisions when quality is at risk.
* Strong written/verbal communication and stakeholder partnership skills; strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving.

**Experience:**

* 4-6 years in data testing/automation, with hands-on ETL, Data Warehouse, and/or Big Data testing experience.
* Proven experience testing pipelines on Databricks/Spark within a medallion or layered Lakehouse architecture.
* Experience with Azure Data Factory and Azure cloud storage constructs.
* Experience validating data through to BI/reporting layers (Power BI, Tableau, or similar), not just the warehouse layer.
* Experience with data quality frameworks/rule design and writing SQL validation scripts reused across both manual testing and automated regression, ideally with exposure to a tool such as Datagaps.
* Experience with SDLC/STLC, Agile ceremonies, and defect lifecycle management; prior ownership of a test strategy independently is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted testing or data validation tools

* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Lead Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test ) to provide end-to-end technical governance across all QA layers — frontend, middleware, and backend — for a complex, multi-layered onboarding platform. This role owns the architecture of API contract testing and the data modeling of complex entity relationships (e.g., hierarchical/parent-child style structures), while ensuring that quality assumptions made at one layer (such as client-side validation) are independently verified at every downstream layer rather than trusted at face value. The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership with the ability to set and enforce delivery governance across cross-functional teams.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide technical governance across frontend, middleware, and backend testing layers.
* Establish and enforce QA delivery standards, evidence requirements, review processes, and quality gates.
* Review frontend constraint dictionaries and FSM/state-model outputs for completeness and consistency.
* Review API schema reconstructions, network evidence, and tracer replay outputs for technical quality and traceability.
* Coordinate with QA Analysts, SDETs, and Test Operations Associates to align technical execution with delivery timelines.
* Review test architecture decisions, validation approaches, and coverage strategies.
* Coordinate dependency resolution, evidence rework, and cross-layer reconciliation throughout the engagement.
* Act as the escalation point for cross-layer technical discrepancies and evidence-quality issues.
* Compile and quality-check the raw technical evidence dossiers produced by the workstreams.
* Identify evidence gaps, inconsistencies, or areas requiring rework before handoff to client stakeholders.
* Report on delivery health, technical risks, evidence quality, dependencies, and unresolved gaps.
* Prepare the technical evidence package for handoff to the client team responsible for final modelling and logic-gap assessment.
* Support technical readout preparation by ensuring that findings are traceable to empirical evidence.

**Project Details**

**Title**: Lead SDET **Rate:** $17/hr  
**Start Date:** 19th October  
**Duration:** 4 Months  
**Commitment:** 22 Hours per Week  
**Location:** India (Remote)  
**Job Type:** Contractual (with the possibility of a Full-time employment extension based on performance and project needs)

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Proven experience of 8+ years in a QA leadership role spanning multiple testing layers (frontend, middleware, backend)
* Demonstrated expertise in API contract testing architecture and governance
* Practical experience with knowledge graph or entity-relationship data modeling and its application to test/data traceability
* Strong understanding of layered system architectures and the importance of independently verifying quality at each layer rather than relying on upstream assumptions
* Strong track record of technical delivery governance, including setting standards and quality gates
* Excellent cross-functional leadership and stakeholder communication skills
* Deep technical grounding across QA disciplines (manual, automation, systems-level testing) to credibly guide teams at every layer
* Experience mentoring or managing SDETs and QA Analysts
* Experience leading complex multi-week technical QA, API validation, or security-assessment engagements is strongly preferred.
* Experience establishing evidence/traceability models across complex technical workflows is preferred.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs, entity-relationship models, or structured technical dependency/evidence modeling is preferred; deep knowledge-graph engineering expertise is not required.
* Ability to synthesize technical evidence into concise stakeholder-ready findings and handoff materials.
